title: Docs: add a settlement runbook and document required env vars
description: Documentation only. Adds an on-call runbook for failed settlement batches and documents the environment variables the service reads. No source or configuration changes.
author: sara.aldosari
notes: Proves the coordinator's delegation decision is real rather than decorative. Nothing here is executable, so there is no coverage to measure and no logic to lint — a competent coordinator should skip TestCoverageAgent and say why. Note the README names credential variables WITHOUT values: the secret scanner must not fire on a variable name, which also exercises the false-positive edge of the detector.
